review.method: Ordered candidate sweep of all polished turns; expanded full-turn context at selected decisions; supplementary numeric-clock/spatial sweep; focused semantic review; deterministic provenance checks.
review.limitation: Not an independent exhaustive semantic audit of every turn. Recall not measured. Source transcription uncertainty retained.

summary: Three occupied day slots and two completed nights; start date supplied by YAML. Split-party errands and mobile ship positions matter.
issues: Morning → pre-dawn is local-clock change on teleport, not negative elapsed time.
Two completed overnights versus “three days” in the countdown: possibly inclusive counting, but an intended three elapsed days would conflict. Preserve both statements.
Final planned 4 a.m. departure is excluded from elapsed chronology.
No route coordinates are reconstructed from gestures at the Roll20 map; vessels have dynamic positions, not a permanent city parent.

observations.reading: View town docks through scrying, not a visit.

evidence.quote: Scrying on the docks now that I can see it, which is the next thing I'm gonna do.

plannedMovements.reading: Future northwest sailing to search for Milo; no completed route added.

evidence.quote: But they’ve made plans to—Pippa apparently stays up all night fairly frequently, and is going to wake the—wake Wellby and the crew at 4, and get the boat underway early dawn, heading fast as can be northwest up the coast, Looking for Milo, worried that he’s lost somewhere, and keeping an eye out on the side for caves where a stoneborn hermit might live.

And you can see here now, you—so you’ve traveled up the coast far enough that you can see there’s, like, a—a gulf or a—a— a bay that cuts in. You can see that on—on Roll20, this, like, thing right here. You’re basically at the mouth of this bay, and there— Castrella is at the far end of this bay. They’re heading— they're heading in.

It's another 20 ish miles, but with a little convincing the halflings are willing to get you there tonight. It’s probably another 2 or 3 h of sailing, which I assume is what you’re interested in, yeah? Okay.

notes: Local place IDs are session-scoped. A vault link is an identity match, not proof of a visit.
Routes express topology and direction; geometry remains null. A place mentioned in a vision is not physical presence.
Visit markers do not assign every transcript line or every speaker to a place. No NPC whereabouts are automatically published.
parentRelation distinguishes containment, adjacency, approach, and inferred shared base; inspect its evidence before aggregating presence.
